Iben Kryger Birkholm is a data manager affiliated with SundK (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) [^src1]. In this capacity, she holds a central role in the data processing and technical operations of the Danish National Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD) [^src1]. Birkholm serves as a member of the [[styregruppen-for-danibd|Styregruppen for DANIBD]], the interdisciplinary steering group that governs the database's methodological validity and operational framework [^src1]. Her participation alongside medical professionals, nursing leaders, and patient representatives underscores the institutional collaboration required to maintain the registry's high coverage and benchmarking capabilities across Danish regions [^src1].
